cells.gaps: The source does not say who enters the attendance and grades or where, and gives no count or share of schools in the Early Warning System; the stage rests on one news report of June 2026. It disagrees with the older facts (ZWE-007 of 2019, ZWE-008 of 2022), which state no learner-level system; the newest stands. No plan or finance is held, and ZWE-006 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: The ministry describes a learner-level system tracking absence and grades at both levels as integrated into EMIS and being rolled out, which is live use past a pilot with no figure published. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results on a share or a count with its total, and none is held.
